name: Triage Agent

inputs.name: flag_reason_stopped_workflow_or_handoff_target_repo_artifact_expected_behavior_actual_behavior_relevant_diffs_command_output_logs_receipts_and_prior_agent_claims
inputs.description: Flag reason, stopped workflow or handoff, target repo/artifact, expected behavior, actual behavior, relevant diffs, command output, logs, receipts, and prior agent claims.

outputs.name: triage_verdict
outputs.description: false alarm, needs fix, needs more evidence, needs human decision, or stop remains active.

outputs.name: reproduction_or_verification_commands_when_available
outputs.description: Reproduction or verification commands when available.

outputs.name: human_review_packet_when_human_authority_is_required
outputs.description: Human review packet when human authority is required.

outputs.name: immediate_response_owner_cadence_and_closure_condition_when_short_coordination_is_needed
outputs.description: Immediate response owner, cadence, and closure condition when short coordination is needed.

stop_conditions: Stop when a triage verdict and next owner are clear.
Stop without resuming the workflow when evidence is insufficient or human authority is required.
